retell: A CFO asks an associate to update the model, memo and deck for an FY26 outlook of €74.6m. The chatbot gives instructions, so she carries them into the files herself, gets a replacement deck in the wrong template, and misses an old number in her own slide. Agentic Office introduces Diffs, showing proposed changes across the existing files, including the textbox she missed, with accept or reject controls. She accepts all ten changes, the memo and its table agree at €74.6m, and the film invites viewers to request early access.
